items.title: GTM & Strategy Analyst
items.snippet: TL;DR: We are looking for a gap-year or final-year student to work alongside the leadership team on Davis's go-to-market, strategy and growth . About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. The role The role is cross-functional. You work directly with the whole team: the CEO and the Real Estate Partner as much as the tech teams. Together with them, you take part in decisions on company strategy, client acquisition and relationships, and product improvement. Your analyses form the basis for these decisions. Client relationships and deliverables Contribute to studies for our developer and investor clients, from data analysis to final formatting. Incorporate client feedback and improve deliverable quality from one version to the next. Gather client needs and feedback, then turn them into concrete proposals to shape the offer and improve the product. Product improvement Turn recurring work methods into automated tools and processes, with the tech teams. Formalise the methods and quality standards these tools reproduce. Test these tools on real cases and suggest improvements. Support their adoption by the team: documentation, onboarding, user feedback. Go-to-market and client acquisition Define the priority client segments and the decision-makers to approach. Build the target account list and identify entry points and partnerships. Prepare prospecting materials and key meetings. Strategy and planning Maintain the business plan and prepare the analyses that inform leadership decisions, including with investors. Profile Education : student at a top business or engineering school, on a gap year or in your final year. Experience : a first internship in strategy consulting, investment banking, growth/VC, a leading real estate investment fund or a start-up. Key skills : strong synthesis and presentation skills , a real appetite for AI tools and a genuine interest in the real estate sector. Analytical skills Ability to study a market (size, dynamics, players, prices, demand), structure it, segment targets and build a clear, verifiable model. Ability to structure a client presentation and deliver it. Rigour and attention to detail in analysis. Strong writing skills, in French and English. Additional skills Strong intellectual curiosity, with an appetite for real estate and for AI tools. Autonomy and the ability to get up to speed quickly on new topics. Ease in dealing with leadership, clients and partners. Enjoys working with tech teams. Knowledge of real estate is a plus. Why join Davis? You will work closely with the leadership team, with a full view of strategy, business development, clients and product. You will have broad autonomy and a direct impact on company decisions. You will learn to use AI as an everyday productivity lever, on high-stakes topics. Package 6-month full-time internship Offices in Paris 75002 Meal vouchers 50% of public transport costs covered More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after: Team Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20 , and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle. Today we're a team of 12 : technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We're small with an extremely high bar . If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need. Why we'll win Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated. Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work : AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

items.title: Junior Product Designer - UI/UX
items.snippet: You turn complex manufacturing data into interfaces factory teams rely on every day, working side by side with our engineers. Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We are a fast-growing team driving massive impact in one of the largest and most under-served industries in the world. We serve the world's top manufacturers across the globe. From Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, our customers trust us to make their factories run better. We are backed by leading investors like Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Google, Meta, Palantir, MBB, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity. WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT? You’ll join our small design team and work directly with our engineers. At first you’ll focus on UI: building screens, components and flows for our platform, and helping our design system grow. Over time you’ll take on larger parts of the product end to end. This is what you’ll do: Turn flows and concepts into detailed production-ready screens. Create and maintain components in Figma, keep them in sync with what’s in code, and notice when patterns start to drift. Pair with developers, review builds, and make quick trade-offs when something doesn’t fit the sprint. Your designs ship; you don’t just hand off Figma files. When a shortcut hurts the experience, you say so, explain why, and propose an alternative. And you know when good enough is good enough. Join customer calls and factory visits, test ideas with our forward deployed engineers, and bring what you learn back into the product. Help where a startup needs it: website updates, sales decks and marketing visuals now and then. WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING? First and foremost, we believe in curious people who are eager to learn and grow. If you're passionate about cutting-edge tech and driving major impact in manufacturing, we want to hear from you. You don’t need to have done it all. We can teach you manufacturing, our product, and a lot about designing complex B2B software. We can’t teach you to care about the details, or to be curious about how things work. Must-haves: You’re fluent in English and comfortable with changing priorities. You know when to be scrappy and when to be thorough. You have 1–3 years of professional experience designing digital products. Internships and working-student roles count if you shipped real work. You have strong UI craft and have hands-on experience with a design system. You’re fluent in Figma (components, variants, auto layout, variables) and comfortable using AI tools for quick iterations and prototypes. You enjoy working closely with developers and understand enough about frontend to design things that can be built. You can explain and stand behind your design decisions, and you change your mind when someone has a better argument. You’re curious about users, technology and how things get made, and you actively look for feedback so you can grow. Bonus: Experience with B2B SaaS, dashboards or data-heavy products WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU? We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. You’ll work alongside two senior designers, get regular design critiques, and sit close to the engineers who build what you design. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. Additionally, we offer: Performance-based career & growth paths On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation Flexible parental leave Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you. We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech. HOW TO APPLY Send us your CV and a portfolio with 2–3 case studies, at least one showing detailed UI work. Tell us briefly what you did yourself and what the team did. Our interview process includes a short design challenge during the on-site, so you can show us how you work. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

items.snippet: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Ogilvy  </strong></p> <p>Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. For more information, visit <u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="7f087527-f491-4cb6-a79d-3b4a67d1ec89">WPP.com</a></u>.</p> <p> </p></div><h2>About InDomo</h2> <p>InDomo is a WPP company and the trusted transformation partner for multinationals ready to unlock rapid digital business growth. We work shoulder-to-shoulder with marketing leaders to build bespoke, in-house performance marketing capabilities that break down silos, put the consumer at the centre, and drive measurable commercial impact.</p> <p>In 2026, our focus has sharpened around AI-powered marketing transformation. We help brands navigate the shift to an AI-driven world by designing new ways of working, deploying intelligent marketing agents, and leveraging WPP Open (WPP’s proprietary AI platform) to deliver breakthrough results. We are scaling our AI practice rapidly and looking for a sharp, motivated intern to join the team and contribute from day one.</p> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>This is not a coffee-and-PowerPoint internship. As our AI & Marketing Transformation Intern, you will be embedded in a small, high-impact team working at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. You’ll support real client engagements, help build AI-powered solutions, and contribute to shaping how some of the world’s biggest brands adopt AI in their marketing.</p> <p>You’ll be given real responsibility, direct access to senior team members, and the opportunity to develop skills that sit at the cutting edge of where marketing is heading. If you’re finishing a Master’s programme and want to hit the ground running in AI-driven marketing transformation, this is the role.</p> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <h3>AI Agent Development Support</h3> <ul> <li>Assist in the design, testing, and iteration of custom AI expert agents for enterprise marketing clients.</li> <li>Help build and refine AI-powered workflows using WPP Open and adjacent tooling, working alongside senior team members.</li> <li>Research and experiment with AI tools, techniques, and frameworks (such as prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and API integrations) to support solution development.</li> <li>Document agent performance, capture learnings, and contribute to our internal knowledge base.</li> </ul> <h3>Workshops & Client Engagement</h3> <ul> <li>Support the preparation and delivery of AI Discovery Workshops and transformation sessions for senior marketing leaders.</li> <li>Help develop workshop materials, including diagnostic frameworks, interactive exercises, and output templates.</li> <li>Attend and contribute to client meetings, with the opportunity to present specific sections or findings as your confidence grows.</li> <li>Support the delivery of internal training and enablement sessions on AI tools and ways of working.</li> </ul> <h3>Go-to-Market & Research</h3> <ul> <li>Help develop pitch decks, case studies, proposals, and other sales collateral for new business development.</li> <li>Conduct competitive analysis and market research to keep our AI propositions sharp and well-positioned.</li> <li>Contribute to the packaging and refinement of InDomo’s AI service offerings.</li> </ul> <h3>Platform & Innovation</h3> <ul> <li>Become proficient in WPP Open, exploring new features and capabilities and sharing findings with the team.</li> <li>Stay on top of the rapidly evolving AI and marketing technology landscape, surfacing relevant tools, trends, and opportunities.</li> <li>Bring fresh thinking. We value your perspective as someone close to the latest academic research and emerging ideas.</li> </ul> <h2>About You</h2> <h3>Must-Haves</h3> <ul> <li>Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, Digital Strategy, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related discipline.</li> <li>A genuine, demonstrable interest in AI and its application to marketing or business. You’ve explored AI tools beyond the basics and can talk about what you’ve learned.</li> <li>Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills. You can structure a compelling deck or write a clear, persuasive brief.</li> <li>Self-starter mentality. You take initiative, work independently when needed, and don’t wait to be told what to do.</li> <li>Available for a full-time, 6-month internship based in Amsterdam.</li> </ul> <h3>Strong Pluses</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with AI tools in an academic or personal project context, such as building chatbots, experimenting with LLMs, using AI coding assistants, or working with APIs.</li> <li>Familiarity with concepts like prompt engineering, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or agent architectures.</li> <li>Previous internship or work experience in marketing, consulting, or a technology-related field.</li> <li>Experience with enterprise platforms (e.g., CRM systems, marketing automation tools, or analytics platforms).</li> <li>Familiarity with Dutch and/or international market dynamics.</li> </ul> <h2>What We Offer</h2> <p>As part of the WPP network, you’ll have access to a world-class professional environment and a comprehensive set of benefits:</p> <ul> <li>Real, meaningful work on live client engagements with some of the world’s biggest brands. items.snippet: Projektmanager Photovoltaik (m/w/d) Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen. Als Projektmanager Photovoltaik (m/w/d) verantwortest du die operative Steuerung unserer PV-Projekte von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zur fertigen Installation auf dem Dach. Du bringst unsere Kund:innen strukturiert, effizient und profitabel durch die gesamte Projektphase und koordinierst dabei eng mit unseren Lieferanten und Installationsbetrieben. Du arbeitest KPI-getrieben, greifst proaktiv ein und lässt kein Projekt liegen. Deine Aufgaben Du steuerst PV-Projekte aktiv von Unterschrift bis Abschluss mit dem Ziel, die Cycle Time konsequent zu reduzieren. Du koordinierst den direkten, operativen Draht zu PV-Modul-Herstellern, Großhändlern und Installationsbetrieben und sorgst für reibungslose Abstimmung bei Beschaffung, Terminierung und Durchführung. Du greifst proaktiv ein, sobald Zeit-KPIs überschritten werden oder Risiken für Durchlaufzeit, Profitabilität oder Kundenzufriedenheit entstehen. Du gewährleistest, dass Projekte vollständig, baubar und jederzeit korrekt im System abgebildet sind und kein Projekt verloren geht. Du behältst die Vollständigkeit der Projektunterlagen im Blick – erkennst frühzeitig, was fehlt, und sorgst dafür, dass es rechtzeitig vorliegt. Du hast die Profitabilität pro Projekt im Griff: Engpässe und Wartezeiten identifizierst du rechtzeitig, bevor sie auf das Ergebnis drücken. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Support Team zusammen und übernimmst die proaktive, projektspezifische Kommunikation zu definierten Kontaktpunkten. Du schaffst transparente und aktuelle Projektstatus und gibst jederzeit Klarheit über Blocker und Handlungsbedarf. Du baust die Prozesse für PV-Projekte aktiv mit auf und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter, da es sie bei uns in dieser Form noch nicht gibt. Bau, Handwerk, Energie). Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (C2). Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools. Erfahrung im Umfeld Photovoltaik, Wärmepumpe oder erneuerbare Energien ist ein Plus. Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig: Ownership – Wenn ein Projekt ins Stocken gerät, hast du das Problem längst erkannt – und bereits gehandelt. Du treibst Projekte intern konsequent voran, adressierst Abhängigkeiten klar und verbindlich gegenüber anderen Teams, und bleibst so lange dran bis das Ergebnis steht. Expert Operator – Du hast viele Projekte gleichzeitig im Blick – und weißt bei jedem, wo es steht, was als nächstes passieren muss und wo Gefahr droht. items.title: Student Placement: Tennis Systems Operator 27/28
items.snippet: Location: UK Based with regular global travel around the world to Tennis Events Contract: Full-Time, Fixed-Term - 12 Months Travel: Extensive global travel to Tennis Events (travel, accommodation and daily living allowance expenses paid by Hawk-Eye) Assessment Date(s): December 16th, 2026 Expected Start Date: Summer 2027 Why Hawk-Eye & Why Tennis? Join us at Hawk-Eye and be part of an exciting journey through the world of sports events. Our operations teams play a crucial role in delivering high-quality experiences at major sporting events worldwide. These are the different areas that you can explore: Technical : Testing, improving and stress testing our systems to enhance the performance of our delivery across the tours. Creative : Working closely with TV directors and external broadcasters to provide statistics and storytelling of insights across tennis matches during live broadcasts. Operations : Reviewing, improving and strategising how we improve the efficiency of delivery across the globe Projects: On-site management of our service delivery across the globe. Liaising with external stakeholders to organise our technical requirements to be ready and sites to be prepared for our arrival, and to deliver our services to the deadline of the events Broadcast Production : Rigging and directing live TV broadcasts across the Masters 1000s ATP tour You will be exposed to each of the areas above and find the discipline that works best for you. As you specialise throughout your time in the Tennis department, there is the option to join a more project-focused team and workflow where you can spend more time in an office-based capacity. However, this does not diminish your opportunity to occasionally travel to some of the biggest Tennis events across the world. What Does A Tennis Systems Operator Do? Installation and setup of Hawk-Eye hardware in the build-up to tournaments, including setting up hardware (cameras, cables, networking devices), calibrating the system and performing pre-match checks. Liaise with key stakeholders, including broadcasters and TV directors, to deliver optimal creative and broadcast impact. Liaising with match officials, tournament stakeholders, organisers and third parties to ensure all contractual obligations are delivered seamlessly. Monitoring and operation of Hawk-Eye ball tracking and broadcast systems across one or more courts during live match play. Applying knowledge of tracking theory and system behaviour to ensure high quality tracking output. Setting up, operating and monitoring systems, ensuring accurate data delivery throughout matches. Managing and delivering video review challenges in line with officiating requirements, including communication with Review Officials where applicable. Assisting with our ‘SMART Production’ broadcast delivery at tennis events throughout the year. Providing quick and effective resolution of technical issues, with the ability to identify when to escalate or seek support. Communicating effectively with supervisors and wider operational teams to ensure smooth match delivery and coordination across courts. Supporting and collaborating with team members, including contributing to the development of less experienced operators where appropriate. Completing all pre and post match operational processes to ensure system readiness and accurate reporting. Maintaining a strong understanding of key tracking and operational software, and applying this knowledge in live environments. Demonstrating an understanding of high quality vs. poor tracking output, and proactively making adjustments to maintain performance standards. Contributing to the research and development of new projects and operational improvements. Maintenance and upkeep of the kit and equipment required to operate the system. Why Is This the Right Job for You? This position is perfect for you if you possess: A technical grounding Strong problem-solving skills Excellent communication and teamwork abilities A passion for innovation A willingness to learn The ability to thrive in a fast-paced and pressurised environment An interest in the sport of Tennis Must be currently studying towards an undergraduate degree At Hawk-Eye Innovations, we appreciate and value the importance of potential and growth. If you do not meet all of the criteria above but believe that there are certain areas you excel and that you possess the passion and desire to develop the other attributes, then we encourage you to apply. Team Culture At Hawk-Eye, we pride ourselves on our team culture. We believe in fostering a supportive environment where every team member can contribute their best work. Our core values include: Innovation: We constantly seek new ways to improve and innovate in the sports entertainment industry. Teamwork: We celebrate our successes and learn from our experiences as a team. Passion: Our love for sports drives everything we do. What Difficulties Might I Face? Up to this point, I’m sure there have been many things that you find intriguing about the role, however, there can be difficult times: Working Hours : Due to the nature of the sports industry, there is often work on weekends and midweek evenings, and we are expected to fulfil our roles until the last ball has been hit. Travelling Abroad : You can expect to spend up to 220 days per year on tour away from home. Whilst there are glamorous locations where Grand Slams are held, there are also some locations that you may not have anticipated that you will be expected to travel to. Please take a look at the following link which shows you some of the locations you could be expected to travel to: https://www.atptour.com/-/media/files/calendar-pdfs/2026/2027-atp-tour-calendar-14-january-2026-updated.pdf Working & Living in Different Time Zones: This role is tour-based, which means you will be spending time away from family and friends, where social events could be missed. items.snippet: Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk. We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural. Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie. Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf . Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken , of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet. Over de functie De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand. Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS. Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit. We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat. De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team. Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat. Wat je gaat doen De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project. Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers. Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge. Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk. Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren. Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators. Wat we zoeken Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder. Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie. Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden. Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen. Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren. Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen. Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. Je leert veel over de bouw, robotica en werken in een snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf. Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van een klein team en weet hoe je mensen begeleidt en motiveert. Je bent operationeel en analytisch sterk. Je kunt een helder operationeel plan uitwerken in een spreadsheet, een winst- en verliesrekening presenteren en verschillende scenario’s doorrekenen, inclusief de factoren die het resultaat bepalen. Je bent een sterke projectmanager. Waarom Monumental? Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen. Jouw werk heeft hier niet alleen impact op het bedrijf, maar op de toekomst van hoe we bouwen. Als je gedreven wordt door innovatie, graag complexe uitdagingen aanpakt en klaar bent om echt verschil te maken, horen we graag van je. Voor open sollicitaties (als je geen rol ziet die precies past) kun je ons mailen op: Helaas bieden we op dit moment geen stageplekken aan. Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen hierboven, maar ben je enthousiast over Monumental en denk je dat je ons toch kunt helpen moeilijke problemen op te lossen? Neem dan contact op. items.title: Academic Dean for MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio
items.snippet: Location : 100% remote (Ohio residency required) Classification : Full-time, exempt Reports to : School Leader Pay Range : $40.00 - $48.00 per hour Welcome to Miaplaza! Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð Role Summary The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Instructional Staff Management Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting. Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers. Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback. Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback. Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals. Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences. Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations. Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed. Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes. Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law. Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together. Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns. Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track. Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas.
